title: Decrement-control descent labels
statement: For a nondeterministic Turing machine $N$ with Boolean tape alphabet, a decrement-control identifier $c$ and natural number $i$ determine a label as follows: if $i$ is less than the stride assigned to $c$, the label is the descent label for $c$ at index $i$; otherwise, it is the read label for $c$.
hypotheses_covered: A nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean tape alphabet
